thread:
devon: quick async — prewarm kicked for delta-region (eu-central-2) at 02:10UTC but only 8/16 GPUs came up. spot pool reported partial allocation. opened ticket #INF-4821 :eyes:

alex: saw it, logs show repeated SpotInterruption warnings and a couple of quota rejects. snippet: ```Provisioner: request 16 g4dn.xlarge -> allocated 8, errors: [SpotInterruption, InsufficientInstanceCapacity]```

maria: I already pushed a quota bump request (+4 GPUs, +64 vCPU) to cloud support, they replied ETA ~6 hours. forwarded case id 987654321.

sasha: can we fall back to the dedicated spare pool for this run? if yes, we should annotate the job with `fallback=dedicated` before retry. @devon can you add that flag? :thinking:

devon: yep will do. plan: 1) requeue prewarm with `fallback=dedicated` 2) reduce batch_size from 64 -> 48 to lower chance of partials 3) trigger one manual reserved allocation for 4 GPUs to stabilize KV cache. doing step 1 now.

infra-bot: [automated] prewarm-job INF-PW-2026 requeued by devon with fallback=dedicated at 02:16UTC. current status: pending -> allocating.

alex: when you requeue, also include `--max-runtime=15m` so we don't hold capacity if it stalls. small config diff: ```--batch-size 48 --fallback dedicated --max-runtime 15m```

maria: quota team pinged engineering contact for more info, they asked for region and exact instance types. reply: eu-central-2, g4dn.xlarge and g5.xlarge. sent.

sasha: if quota doesn't land in time, we should prioritize RPC-critical routes only. can you add route-tag `critical=true` to prewarm set?

devon: got it. I'll restrict to critical routes now and re-run. also adding a tiny smoke-check after allocation: `curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health | jq .tokens_ready` -> expect >= 1

alex: nice. after this completes, let's capture allocation metrics (latency, tokens/s) and post to #observability for trend. :bar_chart:

devon: update: requeue done, fallback engaged, reserved 4 GPUs requested. allocation progressing, infra-bot shows 12/16 now. will follow up with final numbers in ~10m.

maria: thanks — monitoring quota case, will post updates.

sasha: no blockers from me if reserved fallback works.

devon: last: reminder to avoid big parallel prewarms in same AZ for next 24h — let's stagger by 15m windows. logging that as a runbook note. :memo:
